port.description: port of the Zookeeper cluster, by default it's 2181

clusterId.description: the id of the cluster where the zookeeper cluster belongs to, by default it's the cluster where the command is issued.

nodes.description: array of instances created by createEnsemble

startNodeCount.description: the number of servers to bring up when start zookeeper cluster. It must be larger or equal to 3. By default it's 3.

title:
This type implements functions to interact with Zookeeper.
The functions will work only for the cluster where the commands are invoked,
that is, all the path specifications are relative to the cluster root.
name: Zookeeper
